_about: Written by tools/import_zone_kit.gd from data/source/buffet_kit.csv and the art in G:/My Drive/Card Game Art/Approved_ZoneKits/Buffet: one entry per kit id with its lock, family (group / slot), prepared size, pivot (0..1 of the trimmed image), tile size in metres at 400 px/m, sheet parts. EnvKit reads it: every id here resolves like an Environment Kit id (assets/art/zone_kits/buffet/<ID>.webp). Hand-added keys (height, width, tile, placeholder, slot) survive a re-import; entries not on the sheet (aliases) are kept.

BUFF-BD-CAKE.desc: A distant skyline of pastel cake towers, copper domes, and steaming chimneys, hazy.

BUFF-BD-TEST-KITCHEN.use: The far end of the zone

BUFF-DEC-FLOUR.desc: A soft dusting of white flour seen from above, fading edges.

BUFF-DEC-STEAM.desc: Soft warm steam wisps seen from above, very translucent, fading edges.

BUFF-HERO-BROCCOLI-GIANT.desc: An ancient colossal broccoli tree (about 22 m tall) with a thick pale-green stalk and a vast round floret canopy.
BUFF-HERO-BROCCOLI-GIANT.use: Landmark inside the main Buffet zone (broccoli region)

BUFF-HERO-CAKE-CATHEDRAL.desc: A towering many-tiered cake cathedral (about 26 m tall) of pastel frosting and biscuit, with sugar-glass windows, candle spires, and piped-icing buttresses.
BUFF-HERO-CAKE-CATHEDRAL.use: Landmark inside the main Buffet zone (bakery region)

BUFF-HERO-OMAKASE-PAVILION.desc: An elegant, minimal wooden sushi pavilion on white stone cliffs, a single long counter, paper lanterns, overlooking a sea of rice; calm and formal.
BUFF-HERO-OMAKASE-PAVILION.use: Entrance landmark for the Omakase side dungeon (node-based), inside the main zone

BUFF-HERO-POTATO-PEAK.desc: A huge soft hill of mashed potato with a butter-pat summit and gravy streams running down its slopes into a gravy river with little biscuit bridges.
BUFF-HERO-POTATO-PEAK.use: Landmark inside the main Buffet zone (mashed-potato region)

BUFF-HERO-TEST-KITCHEN.desc: The main-dungeon goal: an enormous gleaming industrial kitchen-laboratory complex (castle-sized) with copper domes, towering chimney stacks venting colorful steam, giant whisk and ladle cranes, glass greenhouses, and the half-built silhouette of a food war machine peeking over its walls. Beautiful on the outside but faintly sinister. Must read from across the zone as THE place to go.
BUFF-HERO-TEST-KITCHEN.use: Main dungeon goal, visible from the whole zone
